text_block_list.text:
While out for a walk in the park, some 
children came up and asked me to play 
hide-and-seek with them.

Though they had played several times 
already, none of the children had managed 
to find Still in Love—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad they let me be the ogre. 
Otherwise... the children would have been 
searching for me forever...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...—Come to think of it...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(People search for me often enough, but... 
...I'm rarely the one doing the 
searching...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I want to find everyone... It's lonely 
being the one left behind, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Even if I walk around looking for 
them, this place is huge... but if I run 
and end up bumping into children...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...You really have a knack for finding me, 
Trainer... Just how do you do it...?
choice_data_list:
Actually, I felt like someone was calling 
me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Called for? To me?
choice_data_list:
...Sorry, just kidding. No real reason, I 
guess...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“...Hehe. Somehow, you always know... 
exactly where I am.”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“...It's almost as if we're the only two 
people in the entire world...”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Once I became conscious of that 
space...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Block out the clamor, the wind, the 
rustle of the grass... Filter it all out. 
...Leaving behind only that glowing 
crimson life.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, I feel it. A tiny life moving. I 
can catch it... with a running form devoid 
of waste.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Found you~.

All the children were found, and playtime 
came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It was an educational... and very fruitful 
time.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes... Maybe it will come in handy 
in races, too...

Still in Love seems to have grasped 
something. From that day on, her running 
grew even more refined.
